_comment: Signed announcements envelope v1 (GET /v1/announcements). A NEW envelope beside the notices one on purpose: notice verification rebuilds the canonical preimage from the client's own struct, so a field a deployed client does not know makes every notice fail verification and that client shows nothing at all. Every value here is synthetic.
_encoding_anchor: The third announcement exists to pin the ENCODING, not the content: its body carries an ampersand, an angle bracket pair and two non-ASCII letters, and its call-to-action URL carries two query parameters. The canonical preimage below emits all of them raw, UTF-8, unescaped. An implementation that HTML-escapes & < > (Go's encoding/json does by default) or emits \uXXXX for non-ASCII (Python json.dumps and Jackson's ESCAPE_NON_ASCII do) produces different bytes and therefore a different signature, which is the failure this file exists to catch before an operator writes the first Romanian body.

announcements.headline: Warren production is open
announcements.body: Your beta account gets one free month on production.

announcements.headline: Scheduled maintenance
announcements.body: The API is unavailable tonight between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC.

announcements.headline: Launch offer details
announcements.body: Terms & conditions apply: the offer runs 10:00 <-> 18:00 at the București café.
